newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Venepal Q2 net falls.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Venepal Q2 net falls.

text.p: Net profit 593 million bolivars vs 5.3 billion
Sales revenues 19.8 bln bolivars vs 26.8 bln
Cost of sales 19.0 bln bolivars vs 20.7 bln
Operating profit 2.3 bln bolivar loss vs 3.3 bln profit
Financing gain 137 million bolivars vs 1.8 billion loss
Other revenues 2.7 bln bolivars vs 65 million
All results are in constant April 30 1996 bolivars, the company said, not 1997 bolivars
Venepal SACA is a paper and pulp manufacturer
Net sales 40.6 bln bolivars vs 52.8 bln
Cost of sales 38.8 bln bolivars vs 42.6 bln
Operating profit 4.5 bln bolivar loss vs 3.7 bln gain
Financing gain 797 million bolivar loss vs 3.4 billion loss
Net profit 1.5 billion bolivar loss vs 6.8 billion profit
Notes: Venepal said sales volume over the second quarter rose 15 percent to 47,507 tonnes, compared to the same period of the year before, the rise largely due to a 165 percent increase in exports.
US company Stone Container Corp and Onofre Group Ltd hold 34 percent of Venepal's paid-up capital
